abstract: Peer influence on effort devoted to some activity is often studied when effort is unobserved, and the researcher instead observes an outcome that combines effort with other shocks. For instance, in education, achievement measures such as GPA reflect both effort and idiosyncratic GPA shocks. We propose an alternative approach that circumvents this approximation. Our framework distinguishes unobserved shocks to GPA that do not affect effort from preference shocks that do affect effort levels. We show that peer effects estimates obtained using our approach can differ significantly from classical estimates (where effort is approximated) if the network includes isolated students. Applying our approach to data on high school students in the United States, we find that peer effect estimates relying on GPA as a proxy for effort are 40% lower than those obtained using our approach.
abstract_zh: 摘要 当努力程度不可观测，而研究者仅能观察到结合了努力与其他冲击的最终结果时，关于同伴效应对某项活动投入程度的影响研究往往面临挑战。例如在教育领域，GPA等学业成就指标既反映努力程度，也包含个体特有的GPA冲击。本文提出一种规避此类近似处理的新方法。我们的分析框架将不影响努力程度的不可观测GPA冲击与确实影响努力水平的偏好冲击进行区分。研究表明，当社交网络中存在孤立学生时，采用本方法获得的同伴效应估计值可能与经典方法（将努力程度近似处理）存在显著差异。通过将本方法应用于美国高中生数据，我们发现，以GPA作为努力程度代理变量的同伴效应估计值，比采用本方法获得的估计值低40%。
title: Identifying Peer Effects in Networks with Unobserved Effort and Isolated Students
title_zh: 识别未观测努力与孤立学生网络中的同伴效应

abstract: We construct a continuous-time, monetary model with frictional goods and labour markets to revisit the long-run relationship between inflation and unemployment. By endogenising the value of consumers’ outside options and market power in accordance with standard consumer search theory, we generate novel predictions for the slope of the long-run Phillips curve, optimal monetary policy, and outcomes at the frictionless limit. The relationship between inflation and unemployment is non-monotone and, at low inflation rates, an increase in inflation reduces unemployment. The Friedman rule is suboptimal when firms’ average bargaining power across markets is low. Markups and markdowns vanish as frictions disappear.
abstract_zh: 摘要 我们构建了一个包含摩擦性商品与劳动力市场的连续时间货币模型，以重新审视通胀与失业之间的长期关系。通过依据标准消费者搜寻理论内生化消费者外部选择价值与市场势力，我们为长期菲利普斯曲线的斜率、最优货币政策以及无摩擦极限下的结果提出了新的预测。通胀与失业之间的关系是非单调的，且在低通胀率下，通胀上升会降低失业率。当企业在各市场的平均议价能力较低时，弗里德曼规则并非最优。随着摩擦的消失，加成率与折价率也将消失。
title: Inflation and Unemployment in the Long Run Revisited
title_zh: 长期视角下通货膨胀与失业关系的再探讨

abstract: This paper develops a framework for monetary policy normalization in which liquidity conditions shape aggregate demand through a liquidity channel. The model implies that central bank balance sheet operations can stabilize demand even away from the zero lower bound, making reserves an independent policy instrument alongside interest rates. Optimal balance sheet size therefore depends not only on private reserve demand, but also on fiscal interactions and liquidity management. Following shocks that generate a liquidity trap, optimal policy expands reserves at the lower bound, initiates quantitative tightening before rate liftoff, and normalizes rates and reserves together, clarifying balance sheets’ stabilization role.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个货币政策正常化框架，其中流动性状况通过流动性渠道影响总需求。模型表明，即使在远离零利率下限的情况下，央行资产负债表操作也能稳定需求，使准备金与利率共同成为独立的政策工具。因此，最优资产负债表规模不仅取决于私人准备金需求，还取决于财政互动与流动性管理。在引发流动性陷阱的冲击发生后，最优政策在零利率下限扩大准备金，在加息启动前实施量化紧缩，并同步推进利率与准备金正常化，从而阐明资产负债表的稳定作用。
title: Managing Monetary Policy Normalization
title_zh: 管理货币政策正常化

abstract: There are two major institutional investors in the syndicated loan market: collateralized loan obligations (CLOs) and loan mutual funds. CLOs are closed-end funds while loan funds are open-end funds that issue claims that are redeemable on demand. In this paper, we examine whether CLOs provide arbitrage capital that contributes to the resilience of loan funds. We find that CLOs act as shock absorbers, providing liquidity through par-building trades when loan funds experience large outflows. However, CLO-provided liquidity is limited to par build–eligible loans, leading to potential flow-induced fire sales among par build–ineligible loans. (JEL G23, G38
abstract_zh: 摘要银团贷款市场中有两类主要机构投资者：担保贷款凭证（CLOs）和贷款共同基金。CLO属于封闭式基金，而贷款基金则是开放式基金，其发行的份额可随时赎回。本文考察CLO是否提供套利资本，从而增强贷款基金的韧性。研究发现，当贷款基金遭遇大规模资金外流时，CLO通过平价构建交易提供流动性，起到缓冲器作用。然而，CLO提供的流动性仅限于符合平价构建条件的贷款，这可能导致不符合条件的贷款因资金流动压力而被迫折价抛售。（JEL G23, G38）
title: Institutional Synergies and the Fragility of Loan Funds
title_zh: 制度协同与贷款基金的脆弱性

abstract: Lévy processes are widely used in financial modeling due to their ability to capture discontinuities and heavy tails, which are common in high‐frequency asset return data. However, parameter estimation remains a challenge when associated likelihoods are unavailable or costly to compute. We propose a fast and accurate method for Lévy parameter estimation using the neural Bayes estimation (NBE) framework—a simulation‐based, likelihood‐free approach that leverages permutation‐invariant neural networks to approximate Bayes estimators. We contribute new theoretical results, showing that NBE results in consistent estimators whose risk converges to that of the Bayes estimator under mild conditions. Moreover, through extensive simulations across several Lévy models, we show that NBE outperforms traditional methods in both accuracy and runtime, while also enabling two complementary approaches to uncertainty quantification. We illustrate our approach on a challenging high‐frequency cryptocurrency return dataset, where the method captures evolving parameter dynamics and delivers reliable and interpretable inference at a fraction of the computational cost of traditional methods. We investigate nearly a decade of high‐frequency Bitcoin returns, requiring less than one minute to estimate parameters under the proposed approach.
abstract_zh: 摘要 莱维过程因其能够捕捉高频资产收益数据中常见的间断性和厚尾特征，在金融建模中得到广泛应用。然而，当相关似然函数不可用或计算成本高昂时，参数估计仍面临挑战。我们提出了一种基于神经贝叶斯估计（NBE）框架的快速精确莱维参数估计方法——这是一种基于模拟的无似然方法，利用置换不变神经网络来近似贝叶斯估计量。我们贡献了新的理论成果，证明在温和条件下，NBE可得到一致估计量，其风险收敛至贝叶斯估计量的风险水平。此外，通过针对多个莱维模型的大量模拟实验，我们表明NBE在精度和运行时间上均优于传统方法，同时还能实现两种互补的不确定性量化方法。我们以具有挑战性的高频加密货币收益数据集为例进行方法验证，该方法能够捕捉动态变化的参数特征，并以传统方法计算成本的一小部分提供可靠且可解释的推断。我们研究了近十年高频比特币收益数据，在提出的方法下，参数估计耗时不足一分钟。
title: Fast Likelihood‐Free Parameter Estimation for Lévy Processes
title_zh: 莱维过程的快速无似然参数估计

abstract: This research aimed to evaluate Brazil's performance in achieving the goals and targets related to Sustainable Development Goals (SDG) 13 (Climate Change) and SDG 15 (Life on Land), while systematically assessing how governmental actions align with the mitigation hierarchy (avoidance, minimization, restoration, offsetting, and enhancement). Based on a qualitative content analysis of scientific literature and official evaluation reports, this work contributes to the debate on climate change and biodiversity loss. The research identifies areas of progress and areas that still require attention from policymakers in this context. This study was developed with a qualitative approach and was structured in two stages, namely the scoping review and documentary research based on data retrieved the Institute of Applied Economic Research (IPEA), a foundation linked to the Brazilian Ministry of Planning and Budget. Documentary research identified reports evaluating Brazil's progress on SDG 13 and SDG 15, and document analysis revealed that Brazil has action plans with varying levels of achievement (fully achieved, partially achieved, and not achieved targets) related to biodiversity preservation, climate change mitigation, and sustainable development. Based on the Brazilian actions to mitigate impacts, it was possible to observe a hierarchy with a stronger emphasis on preservation (avoidance) compared to restoration actions, particularly in land management and biodiversity preservation. Furthermore, key points of progress and areas requiring attention from policymakers regarding this topic were also identified. In view of the need for progress in public policies focused on land management and on addressing climate change and biodiversity loss, this research advances the understanding of how integrated mitigation strategies can support the joint achievement of SDG 13 and SDG 15, offering a structured analytical framework to evaluate governmental performance and inform policy design.
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在评估巴西在实现可持续发展目标（SDG）13（气候变化）与SDG 15（陆地生物）相关指标方面的表现，同时系统分析政府行动如何遵循减缓层级原则（避免、最小化、恢复、补偿与增强）。基于对科学文献及官方评估报告的定性内容分析，本研究为气候变化与生物多样性丧失的学术讨论提供了新见解。研究识别了该领域已取得的进展及仍需政策制定者关注的问题。本研究采用定性方法，分两个阶段展开：范围综述与文献研究，数据来源于巴西规划与预算部下属的应用经济研究所（IPEA）。文献研究识别了评估巴西在SDG 13与SDG 15进展的报告，文件分析表明，巴西在生物多样性保护、气候变化减缓及可持续发展方面制定了行动计划，但目标实现程度存在差异（完全实现、部分实现及未实现目标）。基于巴西减缓影响的具体行动，可观察到其减缓层级更强调保护（避免）而非恢复行动，尤其在土地管理与生物多样性保护领域。此外，本研究还识别了该议题下政策制定者需关注的进展关键点与待改进领域。鉴于土地管理、气候变化应对及生物多样性丧失治理领域公共政策亟需推进，本研究深化了对整合性减缓策略如何协同实现SDG 13与SDG 15的理解，为评估政府绩效及政策设计提供了结构化分析框架。
title: A land management, biodiversity preservation, and climate change mitigation analysis in Brazil
title_zh: 巴西土地管理、生物多样性保护与气候变化减缓分析

abstract: This paper provides new micro-level evidence on how labor taxation shapes firm behavior, exploiting an EU-mandated payroll tax reform in Norway. Combining administrative and survey data, we find that firms facing larger tax increases sharply cut employment but also increased R&D spending, implemented labor cost-saving innovations, and adopted more automation. While these responses led to improvements in labor and total factor productivity within the firm, the firm’s labor share fell. These effects persisted even after the tax hike was unexpectedly reversed three years later, suggesting a lasting shift toward more capital-intensive production in response to higher labor costs.
abstract_zh: 本文利用挪威一项欧盟强制实施的工资税改革，提供了关于劳动税收如何影响企业行为的新微观证据。结合行政与调查数据，我们发现，面临较大税负增加的企业大幅削减了就业，但同时增加了研发支出，实施了节约劳动力成本的创新，并采用了更多自动化措施。尽管这些反应带来了企业内部劳动生产率和全要素生产率的提升，但企业的劳动份额却下降了。这些效应在三年后税负意外逆转时依然持续存在，表明企业为应对更高的劳动力成本，已向更资本密集型生产方式发生了持久性转变。
title: Taxing Labor: Firm R&D, Automation and the Labor Share
title_zh: 征税劳动：企业研发、自动化与劳动份额

abstract: We derive conditions for individual choices and $$ \epsilon $$ ϵ -equilibrium prices to be inferred from a finite set of market data in the following sense: Although potential observations are infinite, inference can be attained and known to have been attained after a finite number of observations. While we first examine the case of observations on an individual’s demand at different prices and incomes, our primary focus is on equilibrium, where only profiles of individual endowments and associated equilibrium prices are observable. Our main result is that finite inference is possible in the equilibrium setting if one wants to infer either individual choices or the $$ \epsilon $$ ϵ -equilibrium correspondence.
abstract_zh: 摘要 本文推导了从有限市场数据推断个体选择与ε-均衡价格的条件，其含义如下：尽管潜在观测数据是无限的，但经过有限次观测后，推断不仅能够实现，且可被确认为已完成。我们首先考察了不同价格与收入水平下个体需求观测的情形，但主要关注均衡状态——此时仅能观测到个体禀赋组合及其对应的均衡价格。核心结论是：若需推断个体选择或ε-均衡对应关系，则在均衡框架下有限次推断是可行的。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Exact inference from finite market data

abstract: Does a more persistent demand shock always generate a larger output response? Conventional wisdom says yes: forward-looking agents front-load spending in anticipation of higher lifetime resources, and the more lasting the shock, the stronger the expansion. This paper shows that this logic fails in New Keynesian models with an active monetary policy. The interplay between persistence and monetary policy stance governs a fundamental trade-off between two opposing forces: a permanent income channel that amplifies output, and a real interest rate channel that dampens it. Their balance generates three monetary policy regimes. In the empirically relevant intermediate regime, the output multiplier is hump-shaped in persistence.
abstract_zh: 更持久的需求冲击是否总会带来更大的产出响应？传统观点认为如此：前瞻性主体会因预期到终身资源增加而提前支出，且冲击持续时间越长，扩张效应越强。本文证明，在实施积极货币政策的凯恩斯模型中，这一逻辑并不成立。冲击持久性与货币政策立场之间的相互作用，主导着两种对立力量之间的根本权衡：放大产出的永久收入渠道与抑制产出的实际利率渠道。两者的平衡产生了三种货币政策体制。在具有经验相关性的中间体制中，产出乘数随持久性呈现驼峰形变化。
title: The Power of Persistence: How Demand Shocks and Monetary Policy Shape Macroeconomic Outcomes
title_zh: 持续的力量：需求冲击与货币政策如何塑造宏观经济结果

abstract: We estimate the first time‐varying, county‐level index of housing supply elasticities across the United States, using a structural vector autoregression model with sign restrictions to identify the effect of a positive demand shock. This index reveals four features of the supply curve in different local housing markets. First, supply elasticities are low, on average, generating faster price growth than housing unit growth for most of the country. Second, there is significant variation in elasticities across counties, both urban and rural. Third, elasticities have declined in more counties than they have risen over time, particularly in large urban markets. Fourth, these new estimates predict housing quantity growth better than previous models in the literature.
abstract_zh: 摘要 我们利用带有符号约束的结构向量自回归模型识别正向需求冲击效应，首次估算了美国各县级住房供给弹性的时变指数。该指数揭示了不同地方住房市场供给曲线的四个特征：第一，平均而言供给弹性较低，导致全国大部分地区房价增速快于住房单元增速；第二，城乡各县之间的弹性存在显著差异；第三，随时间推移，弹性下降的县数量多于上升的县，尤其是在大型城市市场；第四，相较于文献中的既有模型，这些新估计值能更准确地预测住房数量增长。
title: Housing Supply Elasticities: A Structural Vector Autoregression Approach
title_zh: 住房供给弹性：结构向量自回归方法

abstract: This paper develops a tractable model of wishful thinking that captures both the benefits and costs of optimistic biased beliefs and the behaviors they induce. Building on Bratcha and Brown (2012) and Caplin and Leahy (2019), we propose a two-stage framework in which a decision maker selects actions and belief structures under uncertainty, balancing subjective utility against the cost of departing from prior beliefs. The cost is formalized using a $$\phi $$ ϕ -divergence–based belief distortion function, encompassing measures such as Kullback–Leibler, reverse Kullback-Leibler, and Pearson $$\chi ^2$$ χ 2 distances. Our contributions are threefold: (i) we characterize optimal beliefs, showing they twist prior probabilities toward high-utility states across a broad class of divergences; (ii) we link WT behavior to risk-seeking actions via convex risk measures; and (iii) we introduce cognitive censoring and cognitive emergence, capturing extreme beliefs. Methodologically, the model provides new insights into how optimistic beliefs reshape decision-making, extending the theoretical foundations of WT and opening avenues for future research.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个易于处理的一厢情愿思维模型，该模型既捕捉了乐观偏差信念的收益与成本，也刻画了由此引发的行为。基于Bratcha和Brown（2012）以及Caplin和Leahy（2019）的研究，我们提出了一个两阶段框架：决策者在不确定性下选择行动与信念结构，在主观效用与偏离先验信念的成本之间进行权衡。该成本通过基于$$\phi $$-散度的信念扭曲函数形式化，涵盖Kullback-Leibler散度、逆Kullback-Leibler散度以及Pearson $$\chi ^2$$距离等度量。我们的贡献有三方面：（i）刻画了最优信念，表明在广泛的散度类别中，最优信念会将先验概率向高效用状态扭曲；（ii）通过凸风险度量将一厢情愿行为与风险寻求行动联系起来；（iii）引入认知审查与认知涌现概念，以捕捉极端信念。在方法论上，该模型为乐观信念如何重塑决策提供了新见解，拓展了一厢情愿思维的理论基础，并为未来研究开辟了方向。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Wishful thinking is risky thinking
title_zh: 一厢情愿是冒险的思维

abstract: Maritime transport remains the backbone of global trade, yet the port and shipping network that carries it has been transformed by containerization and related technological advances. Drawing on newly available granular data—digitized historical shipping records, georeferenced ship movements, and shipment-level routing information—we present five stylized facts on the structure and evolution of the maritime network. Global shipping activity is highly concentrated among a changing lineup of dominant top ports even as lower-ranked ports disperse, while state-owned Chinese port terminal operators increasingly account for these global volumes, boosting overall port operations while delivering efficiency gains mostly to Chinese vessels. We use these facts to organize a synthesis of a fast-growing literature: containerization reshaped which port cities could expand, reinforced hub-and-spoke concentration that yields large but localized welfare gains, embedded ports in multimodal networks that amplify the returns to infrastructure, and generated market power, congestion, and environmental costs. Together, this evidence shows how evolving maritime technologies simultaneously deepen global integration and heighten the economic and geopolitical importance of critical nodes in the transport network—and of who controls them.
abstract_zh: 海上运输仍是全球贸易的支柱，但承载这一运输体系的港口与航运网络已因集装箱化及相关技术进步而发生深刻变革。基于新获取的颗粒化数据——数字化历史航运记录、地理参照船舶轨迹及单次货运路径信息——我们归纳出关于海运网络结构与演进的五个典型事实：全球航运活动高度集中于排名动态变化的头部港口，而低排名港口则呈现分散化趋势；同时，中国国有港口码头运营商在全球吞吐量中的占比持续攀升，在提升整体港口运营效率的同时，其效率增益主要惠及中国籍船舶。我们以这些事实为框架，系统梳理了快速发展的相关文献：集装箱化重塑了港口城市的扩张空间，强化了枢纽-辐射式集中格局（虽带来巨大但局部化的福利增益），将港口嵌入多式联运网络（放大基础设施投资回报），并催生了市场势力、拥堵与环境成本问题。这些证据共同表明，不断演进的海运技术在深化全球一体化的同时，也加剧了运输网络关键节点及其控制者的经济与地缘政治重要性。

title_zh: 评估兽用抗菌药物减量政策的经济效应：中国经验与全球启示

abstract: Promoting green (usually more costly) product consumption is one essential element in building a sustainable society. In times of high inflation, not only budget constraints but also the fear that prices will continue to rise might limit the effectiveness of exerted efforts to promote sustainable behaviors. To test this suggestion, we conducted a Germany-wide survey with almost 1200 respondents, followed by a framed field experiment to confirm causality. Our proxy for green consumption is organic food purchases. Survey respondents’ stated organic purchasing behavior is positively correlated with concerns about climate change but negatively correlated with concerns about inflation. The latter result is driven by individuals with a below-median environmental attitude. In the framed field experiment, we use the priming method to manipulate the saliency of inflation concerns. Whereas sizably relaxing the budget constraint has no impact on the share of organic products in participants’ baskets, the priming significantly decreases the share of organic products for individuals with below-median environmental attitude. Using the same inflation priming in a subsequent survey experiment with around 1800 respondents, we find that high inflationary environments affect both the perception of organic being luxury products and the social norm of buying organic. Both effects are more pronounced for individuals with below-median environmental attitude and, hence, they are the likely mechanisms driving the negative effects on organic product consumption.
abstract_zh: 推广绿色（通常成本更高）产品消费是构建可持续社会的基本要素之一。在高通胀时期，不仅预算约束，而且对价格持续上涨的担忧，都可能限制促进可持续行为所付出努力的有效性。为验证这一观点，我们在德国开展了一项覆盖近1200名受访者的全国性调查，并随后进行了一项框架性实地实验以确认因果关系。我们以有机食品购买作为绿色消费的代理指标。调查受访者所报告的有机购买行为与对气候变化的担忧呈正相关，但与对通胀的担忧呈负相关。后者结果主要由环境态度低于中位数的个体驱动。在框架性实地实验中，我们采用启动方法操纵通胀担忧的显著性。尽管大幅放宽预算约束对参与者购物篮中有机产品的比例没有影响，但启动显著降低了环境态度低于中位数个体中有机产品的比例。在随后一项涉及约1800名受访者的调查实验中，使用相同的通胀启动，我们发现高通胀环境既影响有机产品被视为奢侈品的认知，也影响购买有机产品的社会规范。这两种效应在环境态度低于中位数的个体中更为显著，因此，它们可能是驱动有机产品消费负面效应的潜在机制。
